svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: In the browser: how many times faster
svg.desc: quickertype's WebAssembly engine against quicktype's TypeScript engine, warm, in the same page. pokedex.json (82 KB): 2.2× faster (quicktype 5.1 ms, quickertype 2.3 ms); Generated JSON (20 MB): 2.8× faster (quicktype 404 ms, quickertype 145 ms); Array of 100k small records (27 MB): 2.7× faster (quicktype 179 ms, quickertype 66 ms); The same, generating the code only: 11× faster (quicktype 96 ms, quickertype 8.6 ms).
